scope: Assemble existing exact canonical P7 evidence, execute missing full world/core gate, obtain fresh independent review and verification, propose canonical acceptance. No simulation source mutation or MVP implementation.
required_outputs: Digest-bound original runtime logs and complete PC0 JSONs
notes: This is a bounded control continuation proposal, not a runtime dispatch or a machine-registered active execution. State PLANNED does not claim completion of independent gates. Existing capacity-one closure hold is unchanged. Later evidence is append-only; this proposal remains immutable.

design_brief.problem_statement: P7 runtime is merged and the formal 2032 gate is green, but canonical acceptance and separately required full world/core evidence are missing.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical main routes to P7 closure and denies MVP runtime authorization.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Complete missing evidence and independent roles, then obtain human canonical acceptance before a separate MVP activation.
alternatives_considered: Reuse exact formal train and run only missing world/core gate
design_brief.selected_design: Preserve exact evidence in read-only archives; validate digests, stage accounting and lineage with a non-authorizing audit command; use isolated Actions jobs.
design_brief.why_selected: Closes missing checkpoint predicates without changing already merged simulation or historical evidence.
non_goals: MVP runtime implementation in this Work Order
expected_risks: Full world/core may expose a distinct regression
validation_plan: Frozen packet audit plus negative tests
Unchanged full world/core runner on c14
Fresh independent exact review and verification
